description: This Java source file defines the DefaultCalculatedFieldQueueService class, which implements the CalculatedFieldQueueService interface. It manages queuing and processing of calculated field requests, including handling attribute and timeseries save/delete requests, checking entity conditions, and constructing protocol buffer messages for telemetry.

classes.name: DefaultCalculatedFieldQueueService
classes.description: Service class implementing queuing logic for calculated fields, handling attribute and timeseries requests, and constructing protocol buffer messages for telemetry.

classes.name: FutureCallbackWrapper
classes.description: Wrapper class converting FutureCallback<Void> to TbQueueCallback, delegating success and failure callbacks.

methods.name: pushRequestToQueue
methods.description: Overloaded methods to enqueue timeseries or attribute save/delete requests with optional result and callback.

methods.name: checkEntityAndPushToQueue
methods.description: Checks entity conditions and pushes message to the cluster service if criteria are met.

methods.name: checkEntityForCalculatedFields
methods.description: Determines if an entity has relevant calculated fields based on various filters and relations.

methods.name: toCalculatedFieldTelemetryMsgProto
methods.description: Constructs protocol buffer message for telemetry data from save requests and results.

methods.name: buildTelemetryMsgProto
methods.description: Builds the base telemetry message with entity and tenant info, including previous calculated fields and message identifiers.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Wraps a FutureCallback<Void> into a TbQueueCallback.
